overview: Storage holds as much as you can throw at it: chests, barrels, ender chests, shulker boxes and your own inventory stack a single item into the millions.
Hoppers, droppers, furnaces and everything else automation touches keep vanilla's 64, so sorters and comparator clocks work exactly as they did.

1.0.2: Bundles hold up to 9 kinds of item with 99 of each.
A bundle carrying more from an older world is split into readable portions when you join.
1.0.1: Bundles and shulker boxes keep vanilla's stacking, so two never share one set of contents.
Eating from a huge stack shows the food rather than a missing texture.
Large counts are drawn short, 12k or 3.4m, by Pandorical on the client.
1.0.0: Unlimited stacking in storage, with vanilla stacks kept everywhere redstone reads them.
Comparators still give a signal out of a container holding millions.
